The '''Vorzyd system''' was the main system in the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It centered around the star [[Vorzyd]]. It was the home of the [[Vorzydiak]] species of humanoids and was part of the [[Commonality]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Vorzyd IV]] is mentioned to have several suns in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Threat Within]]''.
